objective: run the complete evaluation-only test24 set through the deployed keyed-schema static-cache route and verify progress, latency, registry integrity, and state isolation

new_dataset_contract.interpretation: All current registry labels were returned exactly once for every image. The schema is generated from the active registry rather than a fixed eight-class constant.

slope_observation.safety_net: Because floor remains visible, the deployed slope recall policy still adds slope to SAM candidate generation without changing VLM visibility, human truth, or training approval.
slope_observation.decision: Do not call slope accuracy accepted. Treat the two changed responses as a recall diagnostic for the next round; keep the independent recall probe and downstream geometry guards enabled.

raw_artifact.reason: The raw per-image benchmark remains a local evaluation artifact; this bounded summary is the tracked evidence.

limits: The 24-image run proves stable execution and registry completeness on this held-out set, not cross-factory segmentation accuracy.
Round50 used a different model route and output protocol, so its latency is not an apples-to-apples speed baseline.
The test24 set has no human pixel masks for slope; the change from five to three VLM-visible slope views is a diagnostic, not a measured precision or recall score.
